tasks.final_text: I just came back home from this volunteering thing at the school where we were giving out icecream for the teachers. It was a little awkward since we had to interrupt a lot of teachers when they were talking to students and parents but it was fun overall and it lasted way longer than expected so I got more volunteer hours.

The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.
